name: Grasping Limb
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The creature can have no more than two targets grappled at a time.
